extracted.name: Mango Gin & Tonic
extracted.description: Summer inspired- guessed how to make it but the salesman did say the mango vinegar makes a good gin and tonic. He was right.
ingredient_lines: 1 Can tonic or make your own tonic
1 Shot glass of gin of choice
1/3 Shot glass Mango vinegar from All of Oils
instruction_lines: Mix 1 shot glass and top with tonic water, leaving room for ice and 1/3 shot glass mango vinegar.
